title: Security and Privacy Controls for Information Systems and Organizations (SP 800-53 Rev. 5, Update 1)

controls.title: Account Management
controls.outcome_summary: Define, provision, monitor, and revoke system, service, and workload accounts according to mission and business need.

parameters.label: allowed account and service-identity types
account review frequency

controls.title: Access Enforcement
controls.outcome_summary: Enforce approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources in accordance with applicable access control policies.

parameters.label: access control policy and authorization boundary

controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement
controls.outcome_summary: Enforce approved authorizations for controlling the flow of information within the system and between interconnected systems or trust zones.

parameters.label: information flow control policies across trust boundaries

controls.title: Least Privilege
controls.outcome_summary: Employ the principle of least privilege, allowing only authorized accesses for users, processes, and agents necessary to accomplish assigned tasks.

parameters.label: scoped privileges granted to processes and tools

controls.title: Authorize Access to Security Functions
controls.outcome_summary: Authorize explicit access for individuals or roles to security-relevant configuration, verification gates, and administrative functions.

parameters.label: protected security functions and verification gates

controls.title: Prohibit Non-Privileged Users from Executing Privileged Functions
controls.outcome_summary: Prevent non-privileged users, untrusted agents, or callers from executing privileged administrative or destructive functions.

parameters.label: privileged or destructive operations

controls.title: Role-Based Training
controls.outcome_summary: Provide role-based security and privacy training to personnel with assigned AI, development, and operational security responsibilities.

parameters.label: roles requiring specialized AI/SI security training

controls.title: Event Logging
controls.outcome_summary: Identify and log security-relevant event types capable of supporting audit investigations across system components.

parameters.label: auditable event types

controls.title: Content of Audit Records
controls.outcome_summary: Ensure audit records contain event type, timestamp, source/actor identity, outcome, and correlation context without leaking raw secrets.

parameters.label: required structured audit fields and redaction rules

controls.title: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting
controls.outcome_summary: Review and analyze system audit records for indications of inappropriate, anomalous, or cascading multi-component activity.

parameters.label: audit review cadence and anomaly triggers

controls.title: Protection of Audit Information
controls.outcome_summary: Protect audit information and logging channels from unauthorized access, modification, corruption, and deletion.

parameters.label: audit stream isolation and integrity protections

controls.title: Control Assessments
controls.outcome_summary: Assess security and privacy controls periodically using independent deterministic assessment procedures (SP 800-53A) to verify effective implementation.

parameters.label: automated and independent assessment gates

controls.title: Continuous Monitoring
controls.outcome_summary: Establish a continuous monitoring strategy tracking configuration drift, model/output drift, and control effectiveness over time.

parameters.label: continuous telemetry metrics and drift thresholds

controls.title: Penetration Testing
controls.outcome_summary: Conduct adversarial testing and red-teaming on systems and components to uncover exploitable boundary or prompt/protocol weaknesses.

parameters.label: adversarial red-team scope and cadence

controls.title: Baseline Configuration
controls.outcome_summary: Develop, document, and maintain under configuration control a current baseline configuration (Golden Template) of the system.

parameters.label: immutable baseline artifacts

controls.title: Configuration Change Control
controls.outcome_summary: Determine types of changes that are configuration-controlled, review proposed changes with automated security impact checks, and retain change records.

parameters.label: change-controlled paths and signoff gates

controls.title: Access Restrictions for Change
controls.outcome_summary: Define, document, approve, and enforce physical and logical access restrictions associated with changes to the system.

parameters.label: read-only vs writable filesystem/repository boundaries

controls.title: Least Functionality
controls.outcome_summary: Configure the system to provide only essential capabilities and prohibit or restrict unused or high-risk functions, ports, protocols, and tools.

parameters.label: prohibited capabilities and maximum active toolset cap

controls.title: System Backup
controls.outcome_summary: Conduct backups of system-level information, configurations, and verified artifacts to support rapid recovery and rollback.

parameters.label: recoverable artifacts and rollback snapshots

controls.title: Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users)
controls.outcome_summary: Uniquely identify and authenticate organizational users and associate that identity with processes acting on their behalf.

parameters.label: user authentication mechanism

controls.title: Authenticator Management
controls.outcome_summary: Manage authenticators by protecting secret material from unauthorized disclosure, avoiding hardcoding, and enforcing rotation.

parameters.label: credential storage and anti-exposure controls

controls.title: Service Identification and Authentication
controls.outcome_summary: Identify and authenticate services, agents, and microservices uniquely using audience-restricted credentials before establishing communications.

parameters.label: service-to-service / inter-agent authentication mechanism

controls.title: Incident Handling
controls.outcome_summary: Implement an incident handling capability covering detection, containment, circuit-breaking, eradication, and recovery.

parameters.label: containment and automated kill-switch procedures

controls.title: Controlled Maintenance
controls.outcome_summary: Schedule, document, and review maintenance, model updates, and dependency upgrades under controlled conditions.

parameters.label: controlled model/software update workflow

controls.title: Media Access
controls.outcome_summary: Restrict access to digital and non-digital media containing training corpora, embeddings, weights, or sensitive artifacts.

parameters.label: protected artifact and dataset storage classes

controls.title: Physical Access Control
controls.outcome_summary: Enforce physical access authorizations at facilities housing compute accelerators, HSMs, and production infrastructure.

parameters.label: facility and hardware security boundaries

controls.title: Security and Privacy Architectures
controls.outcome_summary: Develop security and privacy architectures allocating controls across trust zones, stateless runtimes, and external service boundaries.

parameters.label: architectural trust boundaries and isolation model

controls.title: Risk Management Strategy
controls.outcome_summary: Develop a comprehensive risk management strategy establishing risk tolerance, governance signoffs, and AI RMF alignment.

parameters.label: governance approval thresholds

controls.title: Access Agreements
controls.outcome_summary: Develop and maintain access agreements for individuals and operators handling privileged credentials, datasets, and AI tooling.

parameters.label: privileged operator access terms

controls.title: Authority to Process Personally Identifiable Information
controls.outcome_summary: Determine and restrict processing of personally identifiable information (PII) in prompts, training sets, embeddings, and tool outputs.

parameters.label: authorized PII scope and redaction/projection policy

controls.title: Risk Assessment
controls.outcome_summary: Conduct risk assessments identifying threats, vulnerabilities, likelihood, and impact across AI models, prompts, tools, and dependencies.

parameters.label: threat model scope and risk update triggers

controls.title: Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning
controls.outcome_summary: Monitor and scan software, containers, schemas, and dependencies for vulnerabilities and remediate discovered flaws.

parameters.label: static/dependency/container scan cadence

controls.title: Security and Privacy Engineering Principles
controls.outcome_summary: Apply systems security and privacy engineering principles (defense-in-depth, fail-safe defaults, least privilege, economy of mechanism) in specification and design.

parameters.label: codified secure design patterns

controls.title: Developer Testing and Evaluation
controls.outcome_summary: Require developers and build pipelines to execute static analysis, strict typechecking, unit/contract coverage, and adversarial torture tests.

parameters.label: mandatory pre-release verification gates and coverage floor

controls.title: Development Process, Standards, and Tools
controls.outcome_summary: Require the development process and code-generation toolchains to follow documented security standards (including NIST SP 800-218/218A SSDF).

parameters.label: secure development and codegen toolchain standards

controls.title: Denial-of-Service Protection
controls.outcome_summary: Protect against or limit the effects of denial-of-service and resource/context exhaustion attacks via payload caps, timeouts, and rate/cardinality bounds.

parameters.label: byte, cardinality, recursion, and timeout bounds

controls.title: Boundary Protection
controls.outcome_summary: Monitor and control communications at external system boundaries and key internal trust boundaries, blocking unauthorized egress/SSRF.

parameters.label: egress, SSRF, and transport boundary rules

controls.title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
controls.outcome_summary: Protect the confidentiality and integrity of transmitted information across network and IPC transports.

parameters.label: transport encryption and frame integrity mechanisms

controls.title: Process Isolation
controls.outcome_summary: Maintain a separate execution domain for each executing process and isolate untrusted code or synthesis agents in kernel/container sandboxes.

parameters.label: process/container sandbox mechanism

controls.title: System Monitoring
controls.outcome_summary: Monitor the system to detect attacks, unauthorized connections, anomalous tool invocations, and potential compromises.

parameters.label: runtime telemetry and anomaly detection signals

controls.title: Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity
controls.outcome_summary: Employ integrity verification tools (cryptographic digests, pinned commit SHAs, lockfiles) to detect unauthorized changes to software, models, and data.

parameters.label: cryptographic digest and integrity verification policy

controls.title: Integrity Checks
controls.outcome_summary: Perform integrity checks on software, locked templates, model artifacts, and configuration state at startup, transition, or post-synthesis.

parameters.label: integrity check trigger events and fail-closed response

controls.title: Information Input Validation
controls.outcome_summary: Check the validity of information inputs (JSON Schema 2020-12 types, RFC 9110 header tokens, path confinement, prompt/docstring hygiene).

parameters.label: input and schema validation contracts

controls.title: Supply Chain Controls and Processes
controls.outcome_summary: Establish processes to identify and mitigate supply chain risks across dependencies, CI actions, base images, and foundation models.

parameters.label: supply chain pinning and provenance requirements

controls.title: Provenance
controls.outcome_summary: Document, monitor, and maintain valid provenance of datasets, schemas, models, dependencies, and generated code artifacts.

parameters.label: artifact lineage and provenance metadata
